row: Dr. Suh, pronouced "Dr. Ss-uh", learned the Gonstead Method of Chiropractic since 2005 with more than 500 hours of post graduate training. Studied under the famous Dr. Estey (RIP) for more than 15 years who's expertise is helping those that no one else could help and that's how Dr. Suh also able to help so many people as well. Dr Suh founded Specific Chiropractic since 2009 to bring Gonstead Chiropractic to NYC. On April 2018, Dr Suh earned the prestigious title, Gonstead Diplomate, a rigorous process that test all aspects of knowledge on the Gonstead Method. Dr Suh has over 19 years of extensive training and experience dealing with spinal problems and extremities such as pinched nerves, herniated discs, degenerated discs, hip pain, knee pain, ankle pain, plantar fasciitis, headaches, carpal tunnel syndrome, back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain, and to the bizarre or difficult cases like Chronic Fatigue Syndrome, Meniere’s Disease, Hyperhidrosis, Magenblase Syndrome, etc. etc.
